name: Catalin
text: Catalin is a variant spelling of Cailitin as MacKillop records it. Cailitin is the lone druid hero tied to that name in the old account. Both spellings name the very same figure in the source text. The two word forms stand for one character without any other meaning.

attributes.attribute: alternate written form of the name Cailitin

okr.objective: Record Catalin as a variant spelling of Cailitin
key_results: Point to the hero Cailitin as the same figure
